basic_details.job_title: WBSH&FW Samiti Legal Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: West Bengal State Health & Family Welfare Samiti is hiring one Legal Assistant on contract for its Integrated Law Cell at the State Head Quarter. The pay is ₹32,000 a month. You can apply if you are a law graduate enrolled with the Bar Council of West Bengal, have at least two years of practice in the Calcutta High Court and are not more than 35 years old. The online form opened on 29 October 2026 and closes at midnight on 12 November 2026, and the printed copy must reach Kolkata by speed post by 19 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Pay the fee online by net banking or credit/debit card. It is not refundable. Pay only once.

qualification.details: Not more than 35 years as on 01.01.2026. | Graduate in Law from a recognised University. Must be enrolled in the Bar Council of West Bengal. Basic knowledge of computer application/operation. | At least two years of practice in the Calcutta High Court. Experience counts only from the date you obtained the essential qualification, up to the first date of online application. | You must meet every essential requirement on or before the first date of online application, 29 October 2026. Meeting the minimum requirements does not entitle you to selection. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

selection_process: Selection is based on academic records
proficiency in legal matters and performance at the interview
which carries 5 marks. Eligible candidates will be called for the interview
and its date will be announced later. Marks are rounded off to 2 decimal places. If you are found ineligible at any stage
you will not be called for the next stages.
how_to_apply: Open the WB Health online recruitment portal. You can also reach it from the "On-line Recruitment" link on www.wbhealth.gov.in.
Register by midnight on 7 November 2026 and note your On-line Registration Number. The employer will not supply this number later.
Upload a proper photograph and signature. If these are missing, the application can be cancelled.
Pay the fee online by midnight on 9 November 2026. Once the payment succeeds, the portal takes you back to final submission using your application ID.
Complete the final submission by midnight on 12 November 2026. The details must match your original testimonials.
Download the form from the "Application Print" option on the portal.

Send the print copy, with one set of self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below, by speed post to: Executive Director, State HR Cell, 5th Floor, Swasthya Bhawan-2 Building, Swasthya Bhawan, GN-29, Sector-V, Bidhannagar, Kolkata – 700091. It must arrive by 19 November 2026. The Authority is not responsible for postal delays.
Print copy of the online application form (Registration Form)
Photo identity proof (Passport, Voter ID Card, AADHAAR Card or PAN Card)
Proof of address (Passport, Voter Card or other proof issued by a competent authority)
Age proof (Madhyamik or equivalent examination certificate/admit card)
All marksheets and certificates from Graduation onwards
Documents of enrolment in the Bar Council of West Bengal
Experience certificates issued and stamped by the appropriate authority, from oldest to latest
Keep a printed copy of the registration form for document verification. You will not be allowed into the verification of original testimonials without it.

content_sections.heading: About WBSH&FW Samiti
content_sections.text: West Bengal State Health & Family Welfare Samiti has its office at Swasthya Bhawan, Wing-'B', 3rd Floor, GN-29, Sector-V, Bidhannagar, Kolkata – 700091. Its State HR Cell handles this recruitment. The post sits in the Integrated Law Cell at the State Head Quarter.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Legal Assistant
content_sections.text: Handling case files before the WBAT, the Hon'ble High Court at Calcutta, Consumer Forums and other courts, as assigned from time to time. Preparing Affidavits in Opposition and Grounds of Appeal from the statements of facts that the administrative branches supply. Holding conferences with Advocates and keeping in touch with the administrative branch.

content_sections.heading: WBSH&FW Samiti Legal Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Not more than 35 years as on 01.01.2026. Graduate in Law from a recognised University. Must be enrolled in the Bar Council of West Bengal. Basic knowledge of computer application/operation. At least two years of practice in the Calcutta High Court. Experience counts only from the date you obtained the essential qualification, up to the first date of online application. You must meet every essential requirement on or before the first date of online application, 29 October 2026. Meeting the minimum requirements does not entitle you to selection. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Pay the fee online by net banking or credit/debit card. It is not refundable. Pay only once.

rows.event: Last date for full submission of form
Hard copy to reach the office

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on academic records, proficiency in legal matters and performance at the interview, which carries 5 marks. Eligible candidates will be called for the interview, and its date will be announced later. Marks are rounded off to 2 decimal places. If you are found ineligible at any stage, you will not be called for the next stages.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on contract basis, at the State Head Quarter. The first term is six months. It can be extended from time to time if your service is satisfactory and the higher authority approves. Either side can end the engagement with one month's notice. The decision of the competent authorities is final, and they may cancel the recruitment process at any stage.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WBSH&FW Samiti Legal Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the WB Health online recruitment portal . You can also reach it from the "On-line Recruitment" link on www.wbhealth.gov.in . Register by midnight on 7 November 2026 and note your On-line Registration Number. The employer will not supply this number later. Upload a proper photograph and signature. If these are missing, the application can be cancelled. Pay the fee online by midnight on 9 November 2026. Once the payment succeeds, the portal takes you back to final submission using your application ID. Complete the final submission by midnight on 12 November 2026. The details must match your original testimonials. Download the form from the "Application Print" option on the portal. Send the print copy, with one set of self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below, by speed post to: Executive Director, State HR Cell, 5th Floor, Swasthya Bhawan-2 Building, Swasthya Bhawan, GN-29, Sector-V, Bidhannagar, Kolkata – 700091. It must arrive by 19 November 2026. The Authority is not responsible for postal delays. You will not be allowed into the verification of original testimonials without it.

faq.question: Q1. How many Legal Assistant posts are vacant?
faq.answer: There is one post, and it is Unreserved. It sits in the Integrated Law Cell at the State Head Quarter.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly pay?
Q3. How much court experience do I need?
faq.answer: You need at least two years of practice in the Calcutta High Court, counted after you obtained the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply if I am enrolled with a Bar Council outside West Bengal?
faq.answer: No. The notice requires enrolment in the Bar Council of West Bengal, and you must send your enrolment documents.

faq.question: Q5. On what date is age calculated?
faq.answer: Age is calculated as on 01.01.2026, and the upper limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The first term is six months. It can be extended if your service is satisfactory, and either side can end it with one month's notice.

faq.question: Q7. How many marks is the interview worth?
faq.answer: The interview carries 5 marks. Your academic records and proficiency in legal matters are also assessed.

faq.question: Q8. Where do I send the printed application?
faq.answer: Send it by speed post to the Executive Director, State HR Cell, 5th Floor, Swasthya Bhawan-2 Building, GN-29, Sector-V, Bidhannagar, Kolkata – 700091. It must reach the office by 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What work will the Legal Assistant do?
faq.answer: The Legal Assistant handles cases before the WBAT, the Calcutta High Court and Consumer Forums, drafts Affidavits in Opposition and Grounds of Appeal, and holds conferences with Advocates.
